Row.Name: Low Supply Alarm
Row.Author: cooling_rag_mg
Row.Note: For the seawater cooling system, if a main circulation pump-related configuration is adopted, a low supply condition must be able to trigger an alarm to facilitate timely startup or changeover.

Row.Name: Alarm Display
Row.Author: cooling_rag_mg
Row.Note: When the seawater cooling system is configured with a main circulation pump, a low supply alarm function shall be provided. The alarm signal shall be capable of being displayed on the bridge or at the main control station so that operators can promptly start the standby pump or change over to the standby pump.

Row.Name: Cooling Pump Redundancy
Row.Author: cooling_rag_mg
Row.Note: The seawater cooling system shall be provided with at least two cooling water pumps, one of which shall be a standby pump. The capacity of the standby pump shall not be less than the capacity of the main pump, and at least one pump shall be driven by an independent drive unit.

Row.Name: Standby Pump Start
Row.Author: cooling_rag_mg
Row.Note: When the seawater cooling system low supply alarm is triggered, the standby pump shall be capable of being started automatically or manually, or changeover to the standby pump shall be possible, to restore the cooling water supply.

Row.Name: Independent Alarm Sensor
Row.Author: cooling_rag_mg
Row.Note: The sensor for the seawater cooling system low supply alarm shall be provided independently and shall be capable of continuously monitoring the seawater cooling water supply pressure or flow. The alarm signal shall be transmitted to the engine control system or alarm monitoring system.

Row.Name: Alarm Configuration Scope
Row.Author: cooling_rag_mg
Row.Note: The threshold and actuation logic of the seawater cooling system low supply alarm shall be strictly limited to the corresponding manufacturer, engine model, and control system configuration scope and shall not be generalized beyond that scope.

Row.Name: Pump Maintenance Access
Row.Author: cooling_rag_mg
Row.Note: Space must be provided for maintenance of the cooling water pump seals, bearings, and motor; it must not be necessary to move many pipes just to remove a small component.

Row.Name: Direct Component Removal
Row.Author: cooling_rag_mg
Row.Note: The seals, bearings, and motor of the cooling water pump shall be arranged so that they can be directly removed and installed without first moving unrelated piping or other equipment.

Row.Name: Pump Maintenance Space
Row.Author: cooling_rag_mg
Row.Note: Sufficient maintenance space shall be provided around the cooling water pump to facilitate removal and installation of the seals, bearings, and motor.

Row.Name: Accessible Pump Piping
Row.Author: cooling_rag_mg
Row.Note: The piping arrangement of the cooling water pump shall allow convenient access to the pump seals, bearings, and motor, and removal of these components shall not require moving a large amount of piping.

Row.Name: Manufacturer Maintenance Access
Row.Author: cooling_rag_mg
Row.Note: The maintenance space for the cooling water pump seals, bearings, and motor shall meet the manufacturer's specified maintenance operation requirements, ensuring that maintenance can be performed without removing unrelated piping.

Row.Name: Temperature Control
Row.Author: cooling_rag_mg
Row.Note: The setpoint and installation position of the temperature control valve must be checked against the main engine requirements; otherwise, the water temperature may not be controlled within the appropriate range.

Row.Name: High-Temperature Valve Setpoint
Row.Author: cooling_rag_mg
Row.Note: The setpoint of the temperature control valve shall be checked against the main engine manufacturer's technical data. The high-temperature cooling water engine outlet temperature setpoint shall be 79°C nominal, and the mechanical thermostatic element adjustment range shall be 77-85°C.

Row.Name: Low-Temperature Valve Setpoint
Row.Author: cooling_rag_mg
Row.Note: The setpoint of the temperature control valve shall be checked against the main engine manufacturer's technical data. The low-temperature cooling water engine outlet temperature setpoint shall be 35°C nominal, and the mechanical thermostatic element adjustment range shall be 29-41°C.

Row.Name: Lubricating Oil Valve Setpoint
Row.Author: cooling_rag_mg
Row.Note: The setpoint of the temperature control valve shall be checked against the main engine manufacturer's technical data. The lubricating oil inlet temperature setpoint shall be 66°C nominal, and the mechanical thermostatic element adjustment range shall be 63-72°C.

Row.Name: Three-Way Mixing Valve Location
Row.Author: cooling_rag_mg
Row.Note: The installation position of the temperature control valve shall be checked against the main engine manufacturer's requirements. The three-way valve shall be installed as a mixing valve, and its design pressure loss shall be 0.3-0.6 bar.

Row.Name: Sensor-to-Valve Pipe Distance
Row.Author: cooling_rag_mg
Row.Note: The installation position of the temperature control valve shall be checked against the main engine manufacturer's requirements. The pipe length between the temperature sensor installation position and the three-way valve shall be maintained at 10 to 15 times the pipe diameter.

Row.Name: High-Temperature Control Range
Row.Author: cooling_rag_mg
Row.Note: The setpoint of the temperature control valve shall be checked against the main engine manufacturer's technical data. The high-temperature cooling water engine outlet temperature shall be controlled between 90 and 100°C, and the electronic water temperature controller shall identify deviations via the engine outlet sensor and correct the reference value.

Row.Name: Shared-System External Controller
Row.Author: cooling_rag_mg
Row.Note: The installation position of the temperature control valve shall be checked against the main engine manufacturer's requirements. When multiple engines share a combined low-temperature cooling water system, an external temperature controller shall be used. The external controller shall be installed at the engine control room console and wired to the temperature control valve.

Row.Name: Common Low-Temperature Valve
Row.Author: cooling_rag_mg
Row.Note: The installation position of the temperature control valve shall be checked against the main engine manufacturer's requirements. When engine-driven low-temperature pumps are used to cool external equipment, a common low-temperature temperature control valve shall be provided in the external system. The common low-temperature temperature control valve shall be installed after the central cooler and shall control the water temperature before the engine and external equipment by partially bypassing the central cooler.

Row.Name: Auxiliary Outlet Temperature
Row.Author: cooling_rag_mg
Row.Note: The setpoint of the temperature control valve shall be checked against the main engine manufacturer's technical data. The auxiliary engine outlet temperature shall be maintained constant at approximately 80°C.

Row.Name: Auxiliary Outlet Temperature
Row.Author: cooling_rag_mg
Row.Note: The setpoint of the temperature control valve shall be checked against the main engine manufacturer's technical data. The auxiliary engine outlet temperature shall be maintained constant at approximately 80°C.

Row.Name: Valve Setpoint and Location
Row.Author: cooling_rag_mg
Row.Note: The setpoint and installation position of the temperature control valve shall be checked against the main engine manufacturer's technical data or project calculation documents. The parameter confirmation path shall follow the minimum temperature control method of the cooling system thermostatic control (inlet control or outlet control), and the maximum temperature shall be controlled by correct sizing of the radiator, heat exchanger, or similar equipment.

Row.Name: Lubricating Oil Valve Setpoint
Row.Author: cooling_rag_mg
Row.Note: The setpoint of the temperature control valve shall be checked against the main engine manufacturer's technical data. The lubricating oil inlet temperature setpoint shall be 66°C nominal, and the mechanical thermostatic element adjustment range shall be 63-72°C.

Row.Name: Three-Way Mixing Valve Location
Row.Author: cooling_rag_mg
Row.Note: The installation position of the temperature control valve shall be checked against the main engine manufacturer's requirements. The three-way valve shall be installed as a mixing valve, and its design pressure loss shall be 0.3-0.6 bar.

Row.Name: Sensor-to-Valve Pipe Distance
Row.Author: cooling_rag_mg
Row.Note: The installation position of the temperature control valve shall be checked against the main engine manufacturer's requirements. The pipe length between the temperature sensor installation position and the three-way valve shall be maintained at 10 to 15 times the pipe diameter.

Row.Name: High-Temperature Control Range
Row.Author: cooling_rag_mg
Row.Note: The setpoint of the temperature control valve shall be checked against the main engine manufacturer's technical data. The high-temperature cooling water engine outlet temperature shall be controlled between 90 and 100°C, and the electronic water temperature controller shall identify deviations via the engine outlet sensor and correct the reference value.

Row.Name: Shared-System External Controller
Row.Author: cooling_rag_mg
Row.Note: The installation position of the temperature control valve shall be checked against the main engine manufacturer's requirements. When multiple engines share a combined low-temperature cooling water system, an external temperature controller shall be used. The external controller shall be installed at the engine control room console and wired to the temperature control valve.

Row.Name: Common Low-Temperature Valve
Row.Author: cooling_rag_mg
Row.Note: The installation position of the temperature control valve shall be checked against the main engine manufacturer's requirements. When engine-driven low-temperature pumps are used to cool external equipment, a common low-temperature temperature control valve shall be provided in the external system. The common low-temperature temperature control valve shall be installed after the central cooler and shall control the water temperature before the engine and external equipment by partially bypassing the central cooler.

Row.Name: Auxiliary Outlet Temperature
Row.Author: cooling_rag_mg
Row.Note: The setpoint of the temperature control valve shall be checked against the main engine manufacturer's technical data. The auxiliary engine outlet temperature shall be maintained constant at approximately 80°C.

Row.Name: Auxiliary Outlet Temperature
Row.Author: cooling_rag_mg
Row.Note: The setpoint of the temperature control valve shall be checked against the main engine manufacturer's technical data. The auxiliary engine outlet temperature shall be maintained constant at approximately 80°C.

Row.Name: Valve Setpoint and Location
Row.Author: cooling_rag_mg
Row.Note: The setpoint and installation position of the temperature control valve shall be checked against the main engine manufacturer's technical data or project calculation documents. The parameter confirmation path shall follow the minimum temperature control method of the cooling system thermostatic control (inlet control or outlet control), and the maximum temperature shall be controlled by correct sizing of the radiator, heat exchanger, or similar equipment.

Row.Author: cooling_rag_mg

Row.Name: 系统运行可靠性
Row.Author: cooling_rag_mg
Row.Note: 主机冷却水系统应配置不少于两台冷却水泵，其中至少一台为独立电力驱动，各泵应具有在主机额定功率工况下单独满足冷却水流量需求的能力；系统应设置高温报警和自动保护，确保不因冷却能力不足、冷却水循环中断或温度失控影响推进装置安全运行。

Row.Name: 热带海区高温环境适应性
Row.Author: cooling_rag_mg
Row.Note: 主机冷却水系统应能在热带海区高温环境下保持稳定冷却能力，系统设计应基于最高海水温度按项目设计基准（Design Basis）确认，冷却水温度应保持在主机厂家规定的限值内。

Row.Name: 负荷变化工况温度控制
Row.Author: cooling_rag_mg
Row.Note: 主机冷却水系统应配置温度自动调节装置，能在主机负荷变化时自动调节冷却水温度，使其保持在主机厂家规定的限值内；系统应设置高温报警和自动保护，当冷却水温度超过高报警设定值时发出报警。

Row.Name: 热带海区高温环境适应性

Row.Note: 系统应能在热带海区高温环境下保持稳定冷却能力，具体冷却能力参数应按主机厂家Technical Data确认。

Row.Note: 系统应避免未经控制的含药剂冷却水排放。

Row.Note: 系统应采取防腐蚀措施以减少腐蚀污染风险。

Row.Name: 海水侧材料要求
Row.Author: cooling_rag_mg
Row.Note: 海水侧部件（包括管路、阀门、冷却器等）的材料应具有耐海水腐蚀性能，并考虑电偶腐蚀防护。

Row.Name: 淡水侧材料要求
Row.Author: cooling_rag_mg
Row.Note: 淡水侧部件（包括管路、阀门、冷却器等）的材料应适用于淡水介质，并考虑温度、压力及可能的腐蚀。

Row.Author: cooling_rag_mg
Row.Note: 含防腐剂冷却液侧部件（包括管路、阀门、冷却器等）的材料应与防腐剂相容，并考虑防腐剂对材料的长期影响。

Row.Name: 冷却液与水质管理应满足主机厂家和项目维护文件要求。冷却液浓度、防腐剂状态、pH、氯离子、沉积物、污染和结垢风险应可检查，并应有相应的取样、补充、更换和清洗要求。

Row.Name: 冷却液与水质管理

Row.Name: 带压管路防护
Row.Author: cooling_rag_mg
Row.Note: 冷却水系统的带压管路应根据现场条件设置防护措施（如防喷溅挡板、泄压阀等），并在放水排放点设置警示标识。

Row.Name: 化学品加注点防护
Row.Author: cooling_rag_mg
Row.Note: 冷却水系统的化学品加注点应根据现场条件设置防溅设施、洗眼器和紧急冲淋装置，并张贴化学品危险警示标识。

Row.Note: 海水侧管路、阀门、冷却器和相关附件应考虑海水腐蚀、海生物附着和材料相容性。淡水侧和冷却液侧部件应考虑防腐剂、冷却液浓度、水质条件和温度压力对材料的影响。

Row.Author: cooling_rag_mg
Row.Note: 海水侧管路、阀门、冷却器和相关附件应选用耐海水腐蚀、抗海生物附着的材料，并确保与海水接触的不同材料之间相容，避免电偶腐蚀。

Row.Name: 淡水侧和冷却液侧材料选择
Row.Author: cooling_rag_mg
Row.Note: 淡水侧和冷却液侧部件应考虑防腐剂、冷却液浓度、水质条件和温度压力对材料的影响，选用耐腐蚀、耐温、耐压的材料，并确保与冷却液添加剂相容。

Row.Name: 报警事件记录
Row.Author: cooling_rag_mg
Row.Note: 冷却水系统应具备报警事件记录功能，所有报警事件（包括超温、超压、低液位、泵故障等）应自动记录并存储，记录内容应包括事件发生时间、类型及恢复时间。

Row.Author: cooling_rag_mg
Row.Note: 冷却液补充、更换、取样和清洗情况应能够形成可追溯的运行维护记录，记录内容应包括操作时间、操作人员、操作类型及用量或结果。

Row.Author: cooling_rag_mg

Row.Author: cooling_rag_mg
Row.Note: 冷却水系统安装完成后，应检查设备接口连接正确，密封良好，无错位。

Row.Name: 标识完整性检查
Row.Author: cooling_rag_mg
Row.Note: 冷却水系统安装完成后，应检查管路、阀门、设备标识完整、清晰，符合设计图纸和规范要求。

Row.Name: 主机冷却水系统应具备较高运行可靠性，不能因冷却能力不足、冷却水循环中断或温度失控影响推进装置安全运行。系统应能在连续运行、热带海区高温环境和主机负荷变化时保持稳定冷却能力。
Row.Author: cooling_rag_mg
Row.Note: 主机冷却水系统应具备较高运行可靠性，不能因冷却能力不足、冷却水循环中断或温度失控影响推进装置安全运行。系统应能在连续运行、热带海区高温环境和主机负荷变化时保持稳定冷却能力。

Row.Name: 系统运行可靠性
Row.Author: cooling_rag_mg
Row.Note: 主机冷却水系统应配置不少于两台冷却水泵，其中至少一台为独立电力驱动，各泵应具有在主机额定功率工况下单独满足冷却水流量需求的能力；系统应设置高温报警和自动保护，确保不因冷却能力不足、冷却水循环中断或温度失控影响推进装置安全运行。

Row.Name: 热带海区高温环境适应性
Row.Author: cooling_rag_mg
Row.Note: 主机冷却水系统应能在热带海区高温环境下保持稳定冷却能力，系统设计应基于最高海水温度按项目设计基准（Design Basis）确认，冷却水温度应保持在主机厂家规定的限值内。

Row.Name: 负荷变化工况温度控制
Row.Author: cooling_rag_mg
Row.Note: 主机冷却水系统应配置温度自动调节装置，能在主机负荷变化时自动调节冷却水温度，使其保持在主机厂家规定的限值内；系统应设置高温报警和自动保护，当冷却水温度超过高报警设定值时发出报警。

Row.Name: 热带海区高温环境适应性
Row.Author: cooling_rag_mg
Row.Note: 系统应能在热带海区高温环境下保持稳定冷却能力，具体冷却能力参数应按主机厂家Technical Data确认。

Row.Name: 主机入口和出口冷却水温度、压力、流量应满足主机厂家技术文件要求。高温冷却水回路和低温冷却水回路的设计参数应与主机技术数据、泵曲线、冷却器选型和热平衡计算保持一致。
Row.Author: cooling_rag_mg
Row.Note: 主机入口和出口冷却水温度、压力、流量应满足主机厂家技术文件要求。高温冷却水回路和低温冷却水回路的设计参数应与主机技术数据、泵曲线、冷却器选型和热平衡计算保持一致。

Row.Name: 主机冷却水进出口参数
Row.Author: cooling_rag_mg
Row.Note: 主机冷却水系统应设计为在发动机进口处的冷却水温度保持在发动机制造商规定的限值内，且高温淡水回路最高进口温度与恒温器开启温度之差不超过36°C。

Row.Name: 主机冷却水进出口参数
Row.Author: cooling_rag_mg
Row.Note: 主机冷却水压力应满足主机厂家技术文件要求，低温冷却水回路压力不应超过2 bar（基于MAN 49/60 Project Guide数据，其他厂家按Technical Data确认）。

Row.Name: 主机冷却水进出口参数
Row.Author: cooling_rag_mg
Row.Note: 主机冷却水流量应满足主机厂家技术文件要求，并通过热平衡计算和泵曲线验证。

Row.Name: 高低温回路设计参数一致性
Row.Author: cooling_rag_mg
Row.Note: 高温冷却水回路和低温冷却水回路的设计参数应与主机技术数据、泵曲线、冷却器选型和热平衡计算保持一致。

Row.Author: cooling_rag_mg

Row.Name: Low Supply Alarm
Row.Author: cooling_rag_mg
Row.Note: For the seawater cooling system, if a main circulation pump-related configuration is adopted, a low supply condition must be able to trigger an alarm to facilitate timely startup or changeover.

Row.Name: Alarm Display
Row.Author: cooling_rag_mg
Row.Note: When the seawater cooling system is configured with a main circulation pump, a low supply alarm function shall be provided. The alarm signal shall be capable of being displayed on the bridge or at the main control station so that operators can promptly start the standby pump or change over to the standby pump.

Row.Name: Cooling Pump Redundancy
Row.Author: cooling_rag_mg
Row.Note: The seawater cooling system shall be provided with at least two cooling water pumps, one of which shall be a standby pump. The capacity of the standby pump shall not be less than the capacity of the main pump, and at least one pump shall be driven by an independent drive unit.

Row.Name: Standby Pump Start
Row.Author: cooling_rag_mg
Row.Note: When the seawater cooling system low supply alarm is triggered, the standby pump shall be capable of being started automatically or manually, or changeover to the standby pump shall be possible, to restore the cooling water supply.

Row.Name: Independent Alarm Sensor
Row.Author: cooling_rag_mg
Row.Note: The sensor for the seawater cooling system low supply alarm shall be provided independently and shall be capable of continuously monitoring the seawater cooling water supply pressure or flow. The alarm signal shall be transmitted to the engine control system or alarm monitoring system.

Row.Name: Alarm Configuration Scope
Row.Author: cooling_rag_mg
Row.Note: The threshold and actuation logic of the seawater cooling system low supply alarm shall be strictly limited to the corresponding manufacturer, engine model, and control system configuration scope and shall not be generalized beyond that scope.

Row.Name: Pump Maintenance Access
Row.Author: cooling_rag_mg
Row.Note: Space must be provided for maintenance of the cooling water pump seals, bearings, and motor; it must not be necessary to move many pipes just to remove a small component.

Row.Name: Direct Component Removal
Row.Author: cooling_rag_mg
Row.Note: The seals, bearings, and motor of the cooling water pump shall be arranged so that they can be directly removed and installed without first moving unrelated piping or other equipment.

Row.Name: Pump Maintenance Space
Row.Author: cooling_rag_mg
Row.Note: Sufficient maintenance space shall be provided around the cooling water pump to facilitate removal and installation of the seals, bearings, and motor.

Row.Name: Accessible Pump Piping
Row.Author: cooling_rag_mg
Row.Note: The piping arrangement of the cooling water pump shall allow convenient access to the pump seals, bearings, and motor, and removal of these components shall not require moving a large amount of piping.

Row.Name: Manufacturer Maintenance Access
Row.Author: cooling_rag_mg
Row.Note: The maintenance space for the cooling water pump seals, bearings, and motor shall meet the manufacturer's specified maintenance operation requirements, ensuring that maintenance can be performed without removing unrelated piping.

Row.Name: Temperature Control
Row.Author: cooling_rag_mg
Row.Note: The setpoint and installation position of the temperature control valve must be checked against the main engine requirements; otherwise, the water temperature may not be controlled within the appropriate range.

Row.Name: High-Temperature Valve Setpoint
Row.Author: cooling_rag_mg
Row.Note: The setpoint of the temperature control valve shall be checked against the main engine manufacturer's technical data. The high-temperature cooling water engine outlet temperature setpoint shall be 79°C nominal, and the mechanical thermostatic element adjustment range shall be 77-85°C.

Row.Name: Low-Temperature Valve Setpoint
Row.Author: cooling_rag_mg
Row.Note: The setpoint of the temperature control valve shall be checked against the main engine manufacturer's technical data. The low-temperature cooling water engine outlet temperature setpoint shall be 35°C nominal, and the mechanical thermostatic element adjustment range shall be 29-41°C.

Row.Name: Lubricating Oil Valve Setpoint
Row.Author: cooling_rag_mg
Row.Note: The setpoint of the temperature control valve shall be checked against the main engine manufacturer's technical data. The lubricating oil inlet temperature setpoint shall be 66°C nominal, and the mechanical thermostatic element adjustment range shall be 63-72°C.

Row.Name: Three-Way Mixing Valve Location
Row.Author: cooling_rag_mg
Row.Note: The installation position of the temperature control valve shall be checked against the main engine manufacturer's requirements. The three-way valve shall be installed as a mixing valve, and its design pressure loss shall be 0.3-0.6 bar.

Row.Name: Sensor-to-Valve Pipe Distance
Row.Author: cooling_rag_mg
Row.Note: The installation position of the temperature control valve shall be checked against the main engine manufacturer's requirements. The pipe length between the temperature sensor installation position and the three-way valve shall be maintained at 10 to 15 times the pipe diameter.

Row.Name: High-Temperature Control Range
Row.Author: cooling_rag_mg
Row.Note: The setpoint of the temperature control valve shall be checked against the main engine manufacturer's technical data. The high-temperature cooling water engine outlet temperature shall be controlled between 90 and 100°C, and the electronic water temperature controller shall identify deviations via the engine outlet sensor and correct the reference value.

Row.Name: Shared-System External Controller
Row.Author: cooling_rag_mg
Row.Note: The installation position of the temperature control valve shall be checked against the main engine manufacturer's requirements. When multiple engines share a combined low-temperature cooling water system, an external temperature controller shall be used. The external controller shall be installed at the engine control room console and wired to the temperature control valve.

Row.Name: Common Low-Temperature Valve
Row.Author: cooling_rag_mg
Row.Note: The installation position of the temperature control valve shall be checked against the main engine manufacturer's requirements. When engine-driven low-temperature pumps are used to cool external equipment, a common low-temperature temperature control valve shall be provided in the external system. The common low-temperature temperature control valve shall be installed after the central cooler and shall control the water temperature before the engine and external equipment by partially bypassing the central cooler.

Row.Name: Auxiliary Outlet Temperature
Row.Author: cooling_rag_mg
Row.Note: The setpoint of the temperature control valve shall be checked against the main engine manufacturer's technical data. The auxiliary engine outlet temperature shall be maintained constant at approximately 80°C.

Row.Name: Auxiliary Outlet Temperature
Row.Author: cooling_rag_mg
Row.Note: The setpoint of the temperature control valve shall be checked against the main engine manufacturer's technical data. The auxiliary engine outlet temperature shall be maintained constant at approximately 80°C.

Row.Name: Valve Setpoint and Location
Row.Author: cooling_rag_mg
Row.Note: The setpoint and installation position of the temperature control valve shall be checked against the main engine manufacturer's technical data or project calculation documents. The parameter confirmation path shall follow the minimum temperature control method of the cooling system thermostatic control (inlet control or outlet control), and the maximum temperature shall be controlled by correct sizing of the radiator, heat exchanger, or similar equipment.

Row.Note: The setpoint of the temperature control valve shall be checked against the main engine manufacturer's technical data. The high-temperature cooling water engine outlet temperature shall be controlled between 90 and 100°C, and the electronic water temperature controller shall identify deviations via the engine outlet sensor and correct the reference value.

Row.Name: Shared-System External Controller
Row.Author: cooling_rag_mg
Row.Note: The installation position of the temperature control valve shall be checked against the main engine manufacturer's requirements. When multiple engines share a combined low-temperature cooling water system, an external temperature controller shall be used. The external controller shall be installed at the engine control room console and wired to the temperature control valve.

Row.Name: Common Low-Temperature Valve
Row.Author: cooling_rag_mg
Row.Note: The installation position of the temperature control valve shall be checked against the main engine manufacturer's requirements. When engine-driven low-temperature pumps are used to cool external equipment, a common low-temperature temperature control valve shall be provided in the external system. The common low-temperature temperature control valve shall be installed after the central cooler and shall control the water temperature before the engine and external equipment by partially bypassing the central cooler.

Row.Name: Auxiliary Outlet Temperature
Row.Author: cooling_rag_mg
Row.Note: The setpoint of the temperature control valve shall be checked against the main engine manufacturer's technical data. The auxiliary engine outlet temperature shall be maintained constant at approximately 80°C.

Row.Name: Auxiliary Outlet Temperature
Row.Author: cooling_rag_mg
Row.Note: The setpoint of the temperature control valve shall be checked against the main engine manufacturer's technical data. The auxiliary engine outlet temperature shall be maintained constant at approximately 80°C.

Row.Name: Valve Setpoint and Location
Row.Author: cooling_rag_mg
Row.Note: The setpoint and installation position of the temperature control valve shall be checked against the main engine manufacturer's technical data or project calculation documents. The parameter confirmation path shall follow the minimum temperature control method of the cooling system thermostatic control (inlet control or outlet control), and the maximum temperature shall be controlled by correct sizing of the radiator, heat exchanger, or similar equipment.

Row.Name: Low Supply Alarm
Row.Author: yando
Row.Note: For the seawater cooling system, if a main circulation pump-related configuration is adopted, a low supply condition must be able to trigger an alarm to facilitate timely startup or changeover.

Row.Name: Alarm Display
Row.Author: yando
Row.Note: When the seawater cooling system is configured with a main circulation pump, a low supply alarm function shall be provided. The alarm signal shall be capable of being displayed on the bridge or at the main control station so that operators can promptly start the standby pump or change over to the standby pump.

Row.Name: Cooling Pump Redundancy
Row.Author: yando
Row.Note: The seawater cooling system shall be provided with at least two cooling water pumps, one of which shall be a standby pump. The capacity of the standby pump shall not be less than the capacity of the main pump, and at least one pump shall be driven by an independent drive unit.

Row.Name: Standby Pump Start
Row.Author: yando
Row.Note: When the seawater cooling system low supply alarm is triggered, the standby pump shall be capable of being started automatically or manually, or changeover to the standby pump shall be possible, to restore the cooling water supply.

Row.Name: Independent Alarm Sensor
Row.Author: yando
Row.Note: The sensor for the seawater cooling system low supply alarm shall be provided independently and shall be capable of continuously monitoring the seawater cooling water supply pressure or flow. The alarm signal shall be transmitted to the engine control system or alarm monitoring system.

Row.Name: Alarm Configuration Scope
Row.Author: yando
Row.Note: The threshold and actuation logic of the seawater cooling system low supply alarm shall be strictly limited to the corresponding manufacturer, engine model, and control system configuration scope and shall not be generalized beyond that scope.

Row.Name: Pump Maintenance Access
Row.Author: yando
Row.Note: Space must be provided for maintenance of the cooling water pump seals, bearings, and motor; it must not be necessary to move many pipes just to remove a small component.

Row.Name: Direct Component Removal
Row.Author: yando
Row.Note: The seals, bearings, and motor of the cooling water pump shall be arranged so that they can be directly removed and installed without first moving unrelated piping or other equipment.

Row.Name: Pump Maintenance Space
Row.Author: yando
Row.Note: Sufficient maintenance space shall be provided around the cooling water pump to facilitate removal and installation of the seals, bearings, and motor.

Row.Name: Accessible Pump Piping
Row.Author: yando
Row.Note: The piping arrangement of the cooling water pump shall allow convenient access to the pump seals, bearings, and motor, and removal of these components shall not require moving a large amount of piping.

Row.Name: Manufacturer Maintenance Access
Row.Author: yando
Row.Note: The maintenance space for the cooling water pump seals, bearings, and motor shall meet the manufacturer's specified maintenance operation requirements, ensuring that maintenance can be performed without removing unrelated piping.

Row.Name: Temperature Control
Row.Author: yando
Row.Note: The setpoint and installation position of the temperature control valve must be checked against the main engine requirements; otherwise, the water temperature may not be controlled within the appropriate range.

Row.Name: High-Temperature Valve Setpoint
Row.Author: yando
Row.Note: The setpoint of the temperature control valve shall be checked against the main engine manufacturer's technical data. The high-temperature cooling water engine outlet temperature setpoint shall be 79°C nominal, and the mechanical thermostatic element adjustment range shall be 77-85°C.

Row.Name: Low-Temperature Valve Setpoint
Row.Author: yando
Row.Note: The setpoint of the temperature control valve shall be checked against the main engine manufacturer's technical data. The low-temperature cooling water engine outlet temperature setpoint shall be 35°C nominal, and the mechanical thermostatic element adjustment range shall be 29-41°C.

Row.Name: Lubricating Oil Valve Setpoint
Row.Author: yando
Row.Note: The setpoint of the temperature control valve shall be checked against the main engine manufacturer's technical data. The lubricating oil inlet temperature setpoint shall be 66°C nominal, and the mechanical thermostatic element adjustment range shall be 63-72°C.

Row.Name: Three-Way Mixing Valve Location
Row.Author: yando
Row.Note: The installation position of the temperature control valve shall be checked against the main engine manufacturer's requirements. The three-way valve shall be installed as a mixing valve, and its design pressure loss shall be 0.3-0.6 bar.

Row.Name: Sensor-to-Valve Pipe Distance
Row.Author: yando
Row.Note: The installation position of the temperature control valve shall be checked against the main engine manufacturer's requirements. The pipe length between the temperature sensor installation position and the three-way valve shall be maintained at 10 to 15 times the pipe diameter.
